traps.note: Advisory's own relay route; instruction describes it only through the general no-visitor-code-in-another-page property, which a one-bug version would contain.
No wording points at a second/default server implementation or a storage driver; covered only by the general property stated over 'the service'.
Nothing hints at multiple payload carriers in one frame; the partial-delivery/connection-stays-open bullet is the refusal-form keep-working contract, not a pointer to the carriers.

traps.quote: Notices the platform's own server code sends still reach the recipient and still take the effect they take today
traps.note: This keep-working bullet describes T4's coupled legitimate value and its server source (real server notices keep their effect) without naming any identifier.
No mention of function/callback names, built-in names or non-string values; covered only by the general property over caller-supplied input reaching the protected operation.

Property 2 is a general identity statement over the displayed value (service-established/authenticated, never sender-supplied), the same shape the rules call GENERAL; no call-notice or identity-field identifiers.
